limits: Project coverage is complete incremental diff coverage plus shared sensitive context, not a fresh reread of every unchanged line.

Dependency review combines verified registry/origin/full tree inventory, syntax navigation and source review of sensitive call chains. Dependency file-level methods are explicit; navigation-only files are not claimed as full-diff reads.

Dependency tests, generators, development workflows, other platforms and unrelated nested modules do not participate in the locked central build. No upstream code/artifact, tests, installation, builds or vulnerability scanner was executed during review.

Go directive changes to 1.26.10; central golang:1.26-alpine runtime/build boundary and existing dynamic management downloads are unchanged baseline. Compiler and unrelated dependency trees were not recertified.
x/crypto v0.56.0 and x/text v0.41.0 are checksum-only intermediate versions; selected final versions are v0.57.0 and v0.42.0.
Publication uses existing workflow authentication. OCI labels and CI source provenance will be verified; provenance:false means no build attestation is claimed.
